# Optimity Technologies — Full Knowledge Base

> We build AI into the systems a business already runs. Optimity is a senior engineering team in India, the USA and the UAE working in three practices: AI & Automation, Product Engineering and Enterprise Solutions. Every engagement starts with a free, 30-minute Operations Teardown.

---

## 1. Who we are

Optimity Technologies is a team of senior engineers and architects in India, the USA and the UAE. We build and deploy operational systems for SME and mid-market companies (roughly 50 to 500 people): software, AI and integrations that go into production.

One team does the understanding, the building and the deploying. The people who map a client's operation are the people who write the code and stand next to it in production, so nothing gets lost in a handover.

We build on the systems companies already run. Instead of replacing ERPs, CRMs and operational databases, we add the missing layer on top of them. Where a company has no systems yet, we build them AI-native from the start.

## 2. Practices

1. **AI & Automation**: assistants built on a company's own documents, LLM integrations and private RAG, knowledge engines, and workflow automation for the multi-step work teams do by hand.
2. **Product Engineering**: SaaS products and MVPs, web and mobile applications, and platform and API design, on cloud-native architecture.
3. **Enterprise Solutions**: ERP and CRM integration, Salesforce consulting, reporting and business intelligence, and process automation.

## 3. Kinds of systems we deploy

1. **Workflow automation**: software that does the multi-step work teams do by hand: reading from the ERP, writing to the CRM, moving the order along without the retyping.
2. **Document intelligence**: contracts, invoices, referrals and manuals read into structured, searchable records that staff approve instead of retyping.
3. **Decision support**: the morning questions answered before anyone asks: what's about to go wrong, which account needs a call, what to reorder.
4. **Compliance & audit**: checks that run all the time against a company's own rules and regulations, with a trail that can be handed to an auditor.

Typical stack: ERPNext, Odoo, NetSuite, SAP, Dynamics 365, Salesforce, HubSpot, Shopify, POS systems, EHRs, accounting software, PostgreSQL, WhatsApp and email, and the spreadsheets in between.

## 4. Our own products

### Nexus AI™ (operational intelligence)
Nexus AI connects to a company's ERP, CRM, databases and documents and gives the team one place to ask questions in plain English and act on the answer, without replacing anything. Each question is sent to the engine built for that kind of data:
- **DocIntellect AI™**: questions across documents, contracts and reports. Semantic vector search (RAG) on Qdrant; citations with the source snippet; reads PDFs, Word, Excel, policy documents and financial statements; isolated knowledge bases per team or organisation.
- **SmartOps AI™**: conversational operations for ERPNext, Odoo and HubSpot. Live connectors; summaries such as unfulfilled orders, overdue invoices and pipeline stages; bar, line, pie and donut charts inside the conversation; cross-system reconciliation and operational alerts.
- **SQL Database Agent**: plain English to SQL over production PostgreSQL databases, in strict read-only sandboxes, with sortable and exportable results, automatic charts of trends and anomalies, and fewer ad-hoc report requests for IT and BI teams.
Architecture: no rip-and-replace (no data migration, no retraining, no downtime); strict cryptographic isolation between organisations and teams using Clerk enterprise authentication and isolated database partitions; private LLM deployment with self-hosted, on-premise inference through vLLM, so business data never trains public commercial models; team-level and row-level role-based access control.
Page: https://optimitytechnologies.com/nexus-ai.html

### Move Concierge AI™ (client engagement agent for movers and packers)
Answers moving customers' calls by voice or WhatsApp, including evenings and weekends, collects the move details, quotes, and books the estimator's visit. Captures addresses, dates, home size, lift access and packing needs; itemises inventory room by room; flags heavy or fragile items such as pianos, artwork, gym equipment and safes; estimates weight and cubic footage ranges; sends SMS or WhatsApp quote summaries. Books video or in-person surveys against surveyor availability in the dispatch tool, Google Calendar or booking system; handles rescheduling, cancellations and confirmations; sends a pre-move checklist on WhatsApp 48 hours before; updates customers on truck dispatch and crew arrival. Recordings, searchable transcripts with sentiment analysis, lead scores, conversion funnels and a daily lead summary; webhook sync to MoveOps, Supermove, HubSpot or an internal database. Sub-second voice latency with interruption handling. Optimity builds, tunes and maintains the conversation flows, pricing rules and compliance guardrails.
Page: https://optimitytechnologies.com/move-concierge.html

### Property Connect AI™ (client engagement agent for real estate)
Calls new web leads within a minute of the form, answers listing-sign and marketing-number calls around the clock, answers listing questions (price, square footage, HOA fees, schools), qualifies on budget, mortgage pre-approval and timeline, spots buyers who also need to sell, and books showings into agents' calendars with SMS invites. Warm transfer with a private whisper briefing to the agent before the buyer joins. Script guardrails and fair-housing compliance maintained by Optimity. Full recordings, transcripts and sentiment tracking; CRM sync with Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, HubSpot, Salesforce or custom webhooks.
Page: https://optimitytechnologies.com/property-connect.html

## 5. How we work

Six steps in three stages:

### Understand
- **Understand the operation**: we sit with the people doing the work, not only leadership, and map data, workflows and the systems already in use. Outcome: a clear picture of where AI pays off and where it doesn't.
- **Design the system**: we find the points where intelligence changes an outcome: a decision made earlier, a problem caught before it costs money, a repetitive task that goes away.

### Build
- **Build**: on top of the existing stack, or AI-native where nothing exists yet. The client keeps ownership and control.
- **Integrate**: connect what we build to the ERP, CRM, spreadsheets and messaging the team already uses, so nobody types the same data twice.

### Operate
- **Deploy**: into production, with the team running on it.
- **Improve**: we stay close after launch, so the system is more useful in month twelve than on launch day.

## 6. The Operations Teardown

The first step of every engagement. Free, 30 minutes, and real work rather than a sales call. The client tells us which systems they run; we go through the hand-offs between them and find where work gets stuck. The client keeps the teardown, whether or not we work together. If there's a fit, we write a scoped proposal (what we'd build, on which systems, and the outcome it targets), priced to that scope. No tiers and no "starting at".

## 7. Industries

Sector focus: **logistics & distribution, retail & e-commerce, manufacturing, healthcare, real estate, professional services.**

Logistics runs on an ERP and telematics, clinics on an EHR and fax, retail on POS, Shopify and a buying spreadsheet. In each of them someone is carrying data between systems by hand. We learn each company's version of it and build what's missing.

## 8. Engagement models

- **Product Studio**: we build and run the whole thing, from first discovery to a system the team uses every day. Includes discovery, design and engineering; cloud deployment and operations; an owned roadmap and delivery. Best for new products and AI platforms.
- **Embedded Teams**: senior engineers who work inside the client's team, on their tools, at their cadence. Includes senior engineers and AI specialists; designers and product managers; working inside existing workflows. Best for adding engineering capacity.
- **Strategic Advisory**: a senior technical head when one is needed. Includes technology and AI strategy; architecture and platform reviews; fractional CTO or CPO support. Best for build-or-buy and architecture decisions.

## 9. What clients can hold us to

1. **Clients own what we build.** The code, the system and the roadmap. No platform fee, no lock-in, and we don't hold on to client data.
2. **Built into the stack.** We read from and write to the ERP, CRM and spreadsheets already in use. Nothing gets ripped out to make room for us.
3. **AI only where it changes an outcome.** Where it won't pay, we say so.
4. **Security and reliability by default**, delivered at the speed a 50 to 500 person company moves.
5. **We stay until it runs**, through integration, production and the months after.
6. **Measured by the work it removes**: hours returned, errors caught, decisions made earlier.
